title: Author directive: formalizing NACL 2027 and LDL 2027
locator: Author-confirmed canon directive, NACL/LDL Tier 2 formalization batch
publicLabel: Kairos Universe canon directive: NACL 2027 and LDL 2027 formalization
notes: This is a direct author-confirmed canon directive, not sourced from episode prose.

Formalizes the two remaining Tier 2 regional ecosystems referenced but not yet detailed by the earlier regional-restructuring directive: NACL (North America) and LDL (China), each confirmed by the author at 8 active teams.

NACL 2027 confirmed active teams: Kairos Academy Blue, Blue Otter, Dorado Gaming, Maryville University, NRG, Sentinels (NACL developmental roster, distinct from the organization's LCS Tier 1 team), University of Mississippi, Winthrop University. CCG Esports, Contingent Esports, and Conviction are confirmed inactive for 2027.

Cupid eSports is not named in the author's confirmed NACL active roster or explicit departures list; it is recorded inactive and its players recorded as free agents, for consistency with the confirmed exact-8 active count, and flagged for author review rather than silently omitted.

Kairos Academy Blue becomes Kairos Esports' official active NACL Tier 2 representative effective 2027-01-01 using its existing training roster; this is not a new roster, and Academy Blue remains a distinct entity from Kairos Gaming (LCS Tier 1) and Kairos Academy White (developmental, non-NACL), with no automatic promotion between any of the three.

LDL 2027 confirmed active teams: BLG Junior, TES Challenger, Oh My God, EDG Youth Team, WBG Youth Team, LGD Young Team, WE Academy, AL Young, each a distinct competitive entity from its LPL Tier 1 parent organization even where a parent/affiliate relationship is recorded (Bilibili Gaming, Top Esports, Oh My God, EDward Gaming, Weibo Gaming, LGD Gaming, Team WE, Anyone's Legend respectively).

The LDL participant named 'Oh My God' is recorded as a distinct team entity (parentTeamId-linked) from the existing Tier 1 LPL 'Oh My God' active-membership record; the author explicitly required the identical display name be preserved without inventing an alternate name, while not merging historical Tier 1 membership.

EDG Youth Team, LGD Young Team, and WE Academy remain active in LDL 2027 despite EDward Gaming, LGD Gaming, and Team WE exiting active LPL Tier 1 competition; the directive is explicit that a parent organization's Tier 1 departure does not remove its Tier 2 development team.

Establishes no standings, placements, results, or prize distributions for NACL or LDL 2027, and no automatic Tier 1 promotion or automatic international qualification (Crossroads Challengers, Rift Masters Challengers, WSCI) for any team in either ecosystem.

The pre-existing generic 'LCS Tier 2 2027' and 'LPL Tier 2 2027' competition records are renamed in place to 'NACL 2027' and 'LDL 2027' respectively; their stable IDs and parentCompetitionId links are preserved, and no duplicate competition record is created.
